speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
text: asked	the Minister for Health (a) what is the current success rate of the Professional Conversion Programme (PCP) in the placement and retention of individuals who switch from another industry to the healthcare industry; and (b) what is the current success rate of individuals in the healthcare industry who have been able to switch to higher-end jobs through the PCP.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our public healthcare institutions also support suitable non-clinical healthcare staff to undergo skills conversion through the PCPs and similar programmes to take on clinical roles.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We also provide upgrading opportunities for in-services nurses to take on higher end roles.

speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
text: Could the Minister share if the programme is standardised across all the institutions or is it very customised to individual institutions, as the career the Minister talked about aligns to all the institutions?

speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
text: But in each of the PCP, it will also involve on-the-job training.

speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
text: On-the-job training would be catered more specifically to the institutions, in terms of their practices, team-based approach and so on.

speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
text: There are variations between institutions but the larger part of it is standardised.
